title: Finite homogeneous generators of a finitely generated graded module
statement: Let k be a field and S=k[x_0,x_1], graded by total degree (S_d is the k-span of monomials of total degree d, and S_d=0 for d<0), with the projective-line convention [def-sc-p1-standard]. Every finitely generated Z-graded S-module M has a finite homogeneous generating set m_1,...,m_r; consequently the graded map F_0=direct sum_{j=1}^r S(-deg m_j) \to M (S(e) the shifted graded module [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf] (2)) sending the j-th basis vector to m_j is a surjective graded S-linear map.
